alignment.metadata_policy: data/languages.json is a superset metadata catalog; entries must resolve to canonical, reserve or compatibility-alias codes and do not imply public activation.
alignment.wave1_policy: French is the only activated Wave-1 public pilot. Every other Wave-1 language remains non-public. The existing zh draft route is retained as a compatibility alias for canonical zh-Hans until a separately reviewed route migration.
alignment.deletion_policy: No translator engine, loader, locale, language metadata entry or draft route may be deleted without zero-consumer evidence, dedicated CI and a separate reviewed pull request.
